name: Ride Home
summary: Get a price, book, track, and cancel Uber rides by voice, with a confirmation before anything is booked.
description:
Say "get me a ride home" and Ride Home quotes the trip, shows you the exact price on a confirmation card, and only books after you approve it. Then ask "where's my driver?" or have it tell you when your car is arriving.

Built for the messy parts: if the fare expires or the price jumps before you confirm, it asks again instead of booking a different price. It never books two rides, even if Uber times out mid-request. Surge pricing always goes through Uber's own accept step.

Starts in **Demo** mode with a simulated Uber, so you can try it without an account. Switch to Sandbox or Production after running `bun login`.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Uber.

tools.name: ride_quote
tools.title: Get a ride price
tools.description: Get the price and pickup time for an Uber ride. This only looks up a price and never books anything. Use first whenever the user wants a ride, a car, an Uber, or asks how much a ride would cost, e.g. 'get me a ride home', 'how much is an Uber to the airport', 'book a Comfort to work'. Each request is quoted fresh: don't carry a ride type or pickup over from an earlier request unless the user says so.

destination.description: Where to go: 'home', 'work', a place name, or a street address

pickup.description: Where to be picked up, if the user said. Leave out to use their default pickup

product.description: Copy the user's own words for the ride type from their LATEST message only, e.g. 'Black', 'an XL', 'Comfort'. If their latest message didn't name a ride type, leave this out, even if an earlier message did; the default is used.

tools.name: request_ride
tools.title: Book the ride
tools.description: Book the ride from a ride_quote result after the user says yes to that price. Pass every field exactly as ride_quote returned it in book_with. Never call this without a quote from the same conversation.

children.text: Pickup in {{pickup_eta}}. Your Uber payment method is charged.

tools.name: ride_status
tools.title: Ride status
tools.description: Say where the user's Uber is: driver, car, plate, and how far away. Also reports a ride that ended, was canceled, or found no driver. Use when the user asks 'where's my driver', 'where's my Uber', 'what car is it', or 'what happened to my ride'.

tools.name: track_ride
tools.title: Tell me when my driver is here
tools.description: Watch the user's Uber in the background and report back when the driver is arriving, or if the ride is canceled or can't find a driver. Use when the user says 'tell me when my driver is here', 'let me know when the car arrives', or 'keep an eye on my ride'.

max_minutes.description: Stop watching after this many minutes. Default 20, maximum 45. 0 checks once.

tools.name: cancel_ride
tools.title: Cancel the ride
tools.description: Cancel the user's current Uber. Use when the user says 'cancel my ride' or 'cancel the Uber'. Call ride_status first and pass its request_id and summary, so only that exact ride can be canceled.

summary.description: summary from ride_status, e.g. 'UberX with Maria, Gray Toyota Prius'

children.text: Uber may charge a cancellation fee once a driver is on the way.
